description: Formulates Collatz delay maximization as QUBO, revealing quadratic bit interactions. Classical solvers exploit this Ising-like structure.
mathematical_formalization: delay(n) ≈ sum_i a_i x_i + sum_{i<j} b_{ij} x_i x_j. Maximize x^T Q x.
implementation_hypothesis: LASSO fit of quadratic delay model. Solve QUBO exactly for small B, SA for large B.
experiment_seed: B=30 bit training data. Fit Q. Find maximum. Verify.
